method: Re-read the literal questions against the selected response grids, axis briefs and accessible cited evidence. Checked qualifiers, temporal change, company-versus-person attribution, causal biology versus heredity, faith versus state authority, and each neutral tradeoff. All 1,200 answers are explicitly inferred, including items close to public statements. Structural checks are recorded in verification.json, separately from this substantive review. No peer answers or score targets were used to choose responses.
